quality_gate.interpretation: Paired episode-bootstrap intervals concern the sampled task distribution conditional on this fixed graph and checkpoint. Shared entities do not supply independent graphs or training seeds. Intervals including zero are inconclusive, not positive evidence. Input order must identify the same cached episodes in every arm.
